captions.detailed: A professional shoulder-mount camcorder featuring a boxy dark main body, a top carry handle, a rear-mounted cylindrical eyepiece, and a long multi-tiered front lens barrel. The left side features a small rectangular LCD screen assembly that can swing out, while the top body includes minor red and black rocker controls. The overall finish is a matte black plastic and metal texture with minimal colored accents.
captions.instruction: Generate a professional shoulder-mount camcorder with a boxy main body, a top carrying handle, a rear eyepiece, and a long front lens barrel. Include a left-side flip-out LCD screen with appropriate hinges and small physical controls on the body.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a box primitive and add a top handle using a combination of offset box shapes. Model the lens barrel and rear eyepiece using multiple cylinders of varying radii and lengths. Create the LCD screen assembly on the side using thin boxes, and define the small rocker controls with tiny rectangular extrusions.
